in_marathi.name: Daulati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Daulati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Daulati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘daulat’ meaning wealth, prosperity, or fortune. In Hindu mythology, Daulat is considered the goddess of wealth and abundance. The name is often given to girls to bless them with richness and prosperity in their lives.
